info.title: ASO Hub API
info.description: The Hub's HTTP API, as the console and the aso CLI use it. Send the ASO token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (run `aso token` on the Hub). Answers may carry fields not listed here; ignore what you don't know. Workers and the Architect talk to the Hub over the WebSocket at /ws and Git at /git/<project>.git instead.

conflicts.description: Files left with merge conflict markers for the agent to resolve this round
